recipes.title: Lemon Olive Oil Cake
steps: Whisk the eggs and sugar, then add the oil and lemon.
Fold in the flour and bake for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup
steps: Soften the onion in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Garlic Bread
steps: Mix the butter and crushed garlic.
Spread on the sliced bread and bake for 10 minutes.
